minor_arc_main704.twin: For theta strictly between eleven twentieths and one, epsilon strictly between zero and one and A at least one, the actual normalized reference main term times the cutoff character sum in any reduced wheel class is eventually at most eta x to power theta divided by phi W log x. The estimate is uniform over coprime numerators and denominators with denominator at least log x to power five A and at most Q. It assumes absolute q gamma minus a below one over Q. This proves the unweighted minor arc main term from the burst. It supplies no weighted Harman cancellation.
